source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 64 named Quaternius Animated Man/Woman (poly.pizza, now behind a Cloudflare challenge). Substituted with Casual_Male from the Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019) on OpenGameArt: the best-modelled reachable clothed everyday man with clips in the same file (idle, walk, punch, hit, sit). It has no run clip. The 2017 Animated Human (OGA, has run) is a 1.6k-tri barefoot mannequin whose clothes live in a missing texture; Universal Base Characters (itch.io) are unclothed bodies with no clips in the file (they need the separate Universal Animation Library).
